_note: Scenario hypothesis, not an empirical measure of damage. severity 1-5; cost_fn is charged when an attack of that class is classified as Normal, cost_fp when normal traffic is classified as that class, so both columns are applied per class by expected_cost(). Attack-to-attack confusions are counted, not weighted. Class names match class2 in the X-IIoTID dataset, including the space in 'Lateral _movement'.

Normal.rationale: no attack; only the cost of an unnecessary alert

Reconnaissance.rationale: scanning and discovery, no direct damage

Lateral _movement.rationale: spreads the compromise to other assets

C&C.rationale: persistent remote control of the asset

RDOS.rationale: hits availability of the industrial process

Tampering.rationale: integrity of the physical process, includes false data injection
